pages.lines:
We have 6 Pull-thru sites that are perfect for larger and longer units with toy boxes, trailers and tows.
Each site is allowed one RV or 1 large tent or 2 smaller tents and one vehicle. Extra Vehicles are $5 per day, if space available or the site permits.
Free: Hot individual showers, WIFI thru-out the campground, DVD loaner library,  Book swap, Game nook, Morning Coffee or Tea, and our Tent Village has an outdoor kitchen for prep and clean up.
Site Type	Rate
Tent Site (no services)	$39.
Premium Tent Site	$45.
RV site 30 amp (electric, water, sewer)	$59.
RV site 50 amp (electric, water, sewer)	$69.
RV site 50 amp pull through	$79.
RV Lakeview 30amp (25′ or less only)	$79.
Premium site	$79.
Extra Adult	$10.
Extra Child (under 15)	$5.
HST	+ 14%
NO Visitors on Holiday Weekends
A one hour visit is free; Otherwise a $10 per person fee.
Cancellation Policy
Sites: 7 days prior to arrival date, $25 fee; after 7 days one night fee
Cabins: 14 days prior to arrival date, $35 fee; after 14 days no refund
No Refunds for Early Departures
